RTG thorax PA projection

X-ray picture of chest/horax (AP projection, patient laying down)

Native CT examination of chest/thorax (transverse section, lung window)

Post-contrast CT examination of chest/thorax (coronal section, lung window)
Non-homogenous infiltration in the middle lobe of right lung (arrow) – (pneumonia).

Post-contrast CT examination of chest/thorax (sagittal section, lung window)

X-ray of chest - AP lung projection

Chest X-ray-PA projection-standing position

Chest X-ray -Right side projection

Native CT of chest - axial view - mediastinal window

Postcontrast CT of chest - axial view - mediastinal window

cards.label: Chest | Obrazok 37

Native CT chest - axial view- lung window
left lung: calcification and fibrotic post-inflammatory stripes/streaks

Mammography - RMLO, second picture; cutout

Indication for vacuum biopsy

Ultrasound of liver

cards.label: Mammography | Obrazok 27

Postcontrast CT (transverse section)
Bumpy contour of the liver (full arrow), with its map saturation (?) of parenchyma -> cirrhosis

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 4
cards.title: Obrázok 4 – Cirhóza a ascites – USG (218)
cards.description:
Translation:
Ultrasound of liver
The liver has bumpy contours, map structure with dorsal weakening of echogenicity, nodules are present in
the parenchyma (full arrow). -> cirrhosis
Ventrally is anechogenic fluid (broken arrow) -> ascites

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 5
cards.title: Obrázok 5 – Cirhóza a ascites – postkontrastné CT (219)
cards.description:
Translation:
Postcontrast CT (transverse section)
Bumpy contour of the liver (full arrow), with its map saturation (?) of parenchyma -> cirrhosis
Fluid around the liver (broken arrow) -> ascites

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 6
cards.title: Obrázok 6 - Cirhóza a ascites – postkontrastné MR, T1 (220)
cards.description:

Postcontrast MR – T1 weighted image (transverse section)
Liver with bumpy contour (arrow) with irregular saturation of parenchyma -> cirrhosis
Fluid in abdominal cavity (broken arrow) -> ascites

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 7
cards.title: Obrázok 7 – Absces pečene – USG (221)
cards.description:

Ultrasound of the liver
Hyperechogenic liver lesion (full arrow) with reverberating echophenomes with dorsal acoustic shadow
(broken arrow) -> abscesss

cards.title: Obrázok 8 – Absces pečene a aerobília/ pneumatosis – natívne CT (222)
cards.description:

Native CT (transverse section)
In the liver there is a hypodense formation with gas bubbles (full arrow) -> Abscess
Air in bile duct (broken arrow) -> aerobilia - pneumatosis in bile duct

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 9
cards.title: Obrázok 9 – Absces pečene a aerobília/ pneumatosis – postkontrastné CT (223)
cards.description:

Postcontrast CT (transverse section)
An oval formation with postcpntrast saturation, thickened liquid content and gas in the central part (full
arrow) is present in the liver. Postcontrast-saturating pyogenic membrane -> abscess
Bile air (broken arrow) -> aerobilia - pneumatosis in bile duct

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 12
cards.title: Obrázok 12 – Hepatálne cysty – natívne CT (226)
cards.description:
Translation:
Native CT (transverse section)
Round hypodense well-defined lesions in the liver (arrows) -> cysts

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 13
cards.title: Obrázok 13 – Hepatálne cysty – postkontrastné CT (227)
cards.description:

Postcontrast CT (transverse section)
Round hypodense sharply-defined lesions in the liver (arrows), postcontrast without saturation -> cysts

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 14
cards.title: Obrázok 14 – Hepatálne cysty – natívne MR, T1 (228)
cards.description:

Native MRI - T1 weighted image (transverse section)
Round, hypointense well-defined lesions in the liver parenchyma (arrows) -> cysts

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 15
cards.title: Obrázok 15 – Hepatálne cysty – postkontrastné MR, T1 (229)
cards.description:
Translation:
Postcontrast MR - T1 weighted image (transverse section)
Round, hypointense, postcontrast non-saturating well-defined foci (arrows) -> cysts

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 16
cards.title: Obrázok 16 – Hepatálne cysty – MR, T2 (230)
cards.description:

MRI – T2 weighted image (transverse section)
Round, hyperintense (arrows), well-defined cystic lesions in liver -> cysts

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 18

cards.description:

Ultrasound of liver
Hyperechogenic focus (arrow) in the liver parenchyma -> hemangioma

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 19
cards.title: Obrázok 19 – Hemangióm – natívne CT (233)
cards.description:

Native-CT-axial view
Mild hypodense irregular lesion in liver parenchyme (arrow)
-->Hepatic hemangioma

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 20
cards.title: Obrázok 20 – Hemangióm – postkontrastné CT (234)
cards.description:

Postcontrast CT -abdomen-axial view
Postcontrast characteristic nodular satiety going from periphery to center (arrow)=centri-peripheral direction
of saturation
-->Hepatic angioma

cards.title: Obrázok 26 – Hepatocelulárny karcinóm – natívne CT (240)
cards.description:
Translation:
Native-CT of abdomen- axial view
Irregular, non-homogenous, slightly hypodense, non-sharply defined area (arrow) in right love of liver
-->hepatocellular carcinoma

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 27
cards.title: Obrázok 27 – Hepatocelulárny karcinóm – postkontrastné CT (241)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT of abdomen - axial view
Irregular, inhomogenous, hypodense, non-sharp area (arrow) in right lobe of liver, contains vascular
structures as well
-->hepaticellular carcinoma

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 28
cards.title: Obrázok 28 – Metastázy karcinómu rekta do pečene a nadobličky – natívne CT (242)

Native CT of abodmen - axial view
Hypodense, non-sharp lesions in lover and right adrenal gland (arrows), metastases of rectal carcinoma

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 29
cards.title: Obrázok 29 – Metastázy karcinómu rekta do pečene a nadobličky – postkontrastné CT (243)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT examination (transversal incision) Predominantly hypodensive, non-sharply defined
lesions in the liver and right side (arrow). Postcontrast with mild satiety, metastases of rectal carcinoma
(metastases ad hepar et glandula suprarenalis).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 30
cards.title: Obrázok 30 – Metastázy karcinómu rekta do pečene a nadobličky – MR, T2, TRUFI (244)
cards.description:
Translation:
MR examination T2 weighted image, trufi (coronary section): Predominantly hyperintensive lesions (arrow)
in the liver parenchyma, metastasis of cecal cancer (metastases ad hepar).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 33
cards.title: Obrázok 33 – Cholecystolitiáza – USG (247)
cards.description:
Translation:
Ultrasound examination of the gallbladder: Hyperechogenic gallstones in the gallbladder (full arrow) with
dorsal acoustic tone (broken arrow) (cholecystolithiasis).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 34
cards.title: Obrázok 34 – Cholecystolitiáza, cholecystitída – natívne CT (248)
cards.description:
Translation:
Native CT examination (transverse section): Gall bladder (full arrow) (cholecystolithiasis). Thin hem of fluid
in the gallbladder bed and thickened gallbladder wall (broken arrow (cholecystitis).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 35
cards.title: Obrázok 35 – Cholecystolitiáza – MRCP, T2 haste (249)
cards.description:
Translation:
Magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) T2 haste native (coronal section): Intraluminal
signal defects in the gallbladder (arrow) - stones (cholecystolithiasis)

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 36
cards.title: Obrázok 36 – Renálne cysty, cholecystitída a choledocholitiáza – natívne CT (250)
cards.description:
Translation:
Native CT examination (transversal section): Hyperdense stone in extrahepatic bile duct (full arrow)
(cholesterolithiasis). Its surroundings and surrounding gallstones are inflamed (broken arrow), the
gallbladder wall is thick (coarse arrow) (cholecystitis). Hypodensive, well-defined (star) in the kidney (renal
cystes)

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 37
cards.title: Obrázok 37 – Renálne cysty, cholecystitída a choledocholitiáza – postkontrastné CT (251)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT examination (transversal section): Hyperdense stone in extrahepatic bile duct (full arrow)
(cholesterolithiasis). Its surroundings and surrounding gallstones are inflamed (for an arrow that is
jammed), the gallbladder wall is thick (coarse arrow) (cholecystitis). Hypodensive, non-saturated, well-
defined (star) formations in the kidneys (cystes renum).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 39
cards.title: Obrázok 39 – Cholangiokarcinóm – postkontrastné CT (253)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT examination (transversal section): A non-homogeneous formation in the liver of the liver
(full arrow) spreading along the vascular structures of the liver and bile ducts with dilation of intrahepatic
bile ducts (broken arrow) (cholangiocarcinoma).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 46
cards.title: Obrázok 46 – Pankreatické pseudocysty a ascites – natívne CT (262)
cards.description:

Native CT Examination (transversal section) Hypodensive, sharply defined lesions (full arrow) of the
pancreas tail (pseudocystes pancreatis). Around the liver and under the anterior abdominal wall a
collection of fluid (broken arrows) (ascites).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 47
cards.title: Obrázok 47 – Pankreatické pseudocysty a ascites – postkontrastné CT (263)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT examination (transversal section): Hypodensive, sharply defined lesions (full arrow) of the
pancreas tail (pseudocystes pancreatis). Around the liver and under the anterior abdominal wall, a
collection of fluid (broken arrows) (ascites).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 38
cards.title: Abdomen | Obrazok 38
cards.description:
Translation:
MRCP T2 haste native (coronal section): A wedged signaling concrement (full arrow) with prestenotic
dilatation of the hepatocholedochus duct (choledocholithiasis). Pancreatic duct (dashed arrow) undilated.

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 40
cards.title: Abdomen | Obrazok 40
cards.description:

Pancreas
Native CT examination (transversal section): Peripancreatic leakage (arrow) in acute pancreatitis (pancreas
acuta).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 48
cards.title: Abdomen | Obrazok 48
cards.description:
Translation:
Native CT examination (transversal section); The pancreas head is enlarged by tumor (pancreas
carcinoma). Multiple native iso and hypodensal deposits in the liver (one indicated by dotted arrow)
(metastases ad hepar).

cards.label: Abdomen | Obrazok 49
cards.title: Abdomen | Obrazok 49
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT examination (transversal section): In the head of the pancreas there is a tumor site that is
less saturated than the surrounding normal parenchyma (full arrow), (carcinoma pancreatis). Hypodensal
deposits in the liver (one marked with a broken arrow) (metastases ad hepar).

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 4

horseshoe kidney (ren arcuatus).

kidney poles (arrow), congenital variation - horseshoe kidney (ren arcuatus)

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 6
cards.title: Obrázok 6 – Ren arcuata – MR, T2 (278)

MR examination - T2 weighted image (transversal section): Connected lower kidney poles (arrow),
congenital variation - horseshoe kidney (ren arcuatus)

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 10

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 12

postcontrast (kidney arrow) under the inflammation (pyelonephritis)

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 17

->kidney cyst

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 18

Round, sharply defined, hypodense formations in both kidneys
->Kidney cysts

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 19

renum).
Contrast medium visible in right kidney tubular system (broken arrow)

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 20
cards.title: Obrázok 20 – Renálna cysta – MR, T1 (292)

Native MRI – T1 weighted image with fat suppression - axial view
Hypointense round area in right kidney parenchyme (arrow)
->kidney cyst

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 21
cards.title: Obrázok 21 – Renálna cysta – MR, T1 STIR (293)
cards.description:

postcontrast MRI – T1 weighted image with fat suppression - axial view
Hypointense cystic formation in right kidney (arrow), without postcontrast saturation
->kidney cyst

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 22

->kidney cyst

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 24
cards.title: Obrázok 24 – Polycystické obličky – postkontrastné CT (296)

Postcontrast CT – axial view
Multiple postcontrast non-saturating formations in both kidneys, with characteristic of cysts-> polycystic
kidneys.
Simple cysts are hypodense (full arrow), complicated cysts are hyperdense (broken arrow).

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 25
cards.title: Obrázok 25 – Angiomyolipóm – natívne CT (297)

Hypodense focus in in ventral part of right kidney (arrow), density of the focus corresponds to fat.

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 26
cards.title: Obrázok 26 – Angiomyolipóm – postkontrastné CT (298)

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 27

->angiomyolipoma

->angiomyolipoma

Renal carcinoma

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 32

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 43

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 44

cards.description:
Translation:
Postcontrast MRI T1 weighted image with fat supression (coronal view):
Inhomogenous lesion in region of right adrenal gland (arrow) (pheochromocytoma).

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 49

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 9

suprarenalis).

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 41
cards.title: Urogenital system | Obrazok 41

Round, mildly /slightly inhomogenous formation/ lesion of the left adrenal gland (arrow),
hypodense districts/ regions representing fat component/ content (myelolipoma glandulae
suprarenalis).

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 45
cards.title: Urogenital system | Obrazok 45

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 46
cards.title: Urogenital system | Obrazok 46
cards.description:

Postcontrast CT (axial view):
Irregular lesion in the left adrenal gland lobed contours (arrow) – metastasis of lung carcinoma in

cards.label: Urogenital system | Obrazok 55
cards.title: Urogenital system | Obrazok 55
cards.description:
Translation:
MRI – T2 weighted image (sagital section):
Lesion in cervix of uterus – uterine cervix carcinoma (arrow) (carcinoma cervicis uteri).
Not in text: lesion is round and hyperintense compared to uterus. Uterus in anteflexion
(physiological position), hyperintense (fluid) in urinary bladder.

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 1
cards.title: Obrázok 1 – Zenkerov divertikul – RTG, AP/ bočná projekcia (335)
cards.description:
Translation:
Gastrointestinal tract
X-ray of esophageal passage (anteroposterior and lateral view):
Contrast agent stagnates in the arch/curvature of the dorsal wall of the esophagus (arrow)
(Zenkers diverticulum).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 2
cards.title: Obrázok 2 – Achalázia ezofágu – RTG s jódovou KL, AP projekcia (336)
cards.description:
Translation:
X-ray of esophageal passage (oral iodine contrast agent, anteroposterior view):
Esophageal dilation, contrast agent pass through stenotic cardia (arrow) into the stomach only in small
quantities, on the right x-ray a beaked constriction of the lumen is pictured (esophageal achalasia).
Not in text but: the right picture shows the «bird beak» sign.

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 3
cards.title: Obrázok 3 – Achalázia ezofágu – postkontrastné CT (337)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post contrast CT examination (transverse slice/section):
Stagnation of fluid contents in dilated esophagus (arrow)
(esophageal achalasia).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 4
cards.title: Obrázok 4 – Karcinóm ezofágu – RTG, AP/ bočná projekcia (338)
cards.description:
Translation:
X-ray of esophageal passage (anteroposterior, oblique view):
Reduction of esophageal lumen with uneven irregular edges in the middle third (arrows) with pre-stenotic
dilation (esophageal carcinoma).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 5
cards.title: Obrázok 5 – Karcinóm ezofágu – natívne CT (339)
cards.description:
Translation:
Native CT examination (transverse slice/section):
Thickened wall of esophagus (arrow), lumen of esophagus is undifferentiable
(esophageal carcinoma).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 6
cards.title: Obrázok 6 – Karcinóm ezofágu – postkontrastné CT (340)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post contrast CT examination, contrast agent is administered orally (transverse slice/section):
Irregular thickening of esophageal wall (arrow) (esophageal carcinoma).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 24
cards.title: Obrázok 24 – Ileus tenkého čreva – postkontrastné CT (358)
cards.description:
Translation:
Postcontrast CT – axial view
Small intestines are dilated with fluid (small arrow), free fluid between loops of intestine, left large intestine
are not dilated
->Ileus of small intestine

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 25
cards.title: Obrázok 25 – Ileus hrubého čreva – natívne CT (359)
cards.description:

Native CT – axial view
Large intestine are dilated with fluid-air levels (full arrow), small intestines are without dilation (broken
arrow)
->Ileus of large intestine

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 26
cards.title: Obrázok 26 – Ileus hrubého čreva – postkontrastné CT (360)
cards.description:
Translation:
Postcontrast CT – axial view
Large intestines are dilated, contain fluid-air levels (full arrow), small intestines without dilation (broken
arrow)
->ileus of large intestine

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 27

cards.description:

Ultrasound of appendix
Tubular blind ending in right hypogastrium. Thickened wall (arrow)

cards.description:

Ultrasound of intestine
On the ultrasound image you can see invagination of terminal ileum (full arrow) into cecum (broken arrow)
->Invagination/Intussusception

Native CT-axial view
Irregular thickening of cecum wall, blurry shape

cards.description:

CT virtual colonoscopy
Circular stenosis of ascending colon due to circular infiltrating adenocarcinoma (arrow)

cards.title: Obrázok 34, 35 – Adenokarcinóm hrubého čreva – CT virtuálna kolonoskopia, VRT rekonštrukcia (368)
cards.description:

Native CT – axial view
Irregular thickening of sigmoid wall, blurry outlines with surrounding fat tissue infiltration.
->Carcinoma of sigmoid colon

cards.title: Obrázok 36 – Karcinóm sigmy – natívne CT (369)
cards.description:

Postcontrast saturation of thickened sigmoid wall, blurry outlines of surrounding fat tissue infiltration
(arrow)
->carcinoma of sigmoid colon

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 37
cards.title: Obrázok 37 – Karcinóm sigmy – postkontrastné CT (370)
cards.description:

CT virtual colonoscopy
Intraluminal growing adenocarcinoma in sigmoid colon
->adenocarcinoma of sigmoid colon

->Rectal carcinoma

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 39
cards.title: Obrázok 39 – Karcinóm rekta – natívne CT (372)
cards.description:

Post-contrast CT – axial view
Irregular thick post-contrast saturation of rectal wall (arrow), with surrounding fat tissue infiltration
->rectal carcinoma

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 40
cards.title: Obrázok 40 – Karcinóm rekta – postkontrastné CT (373)
cards.description:
Translation:
MRI-T2 weighted image – sagittal view
Non-homogenous mass in area of rectosigmoid, Irregular thickening of wall
->carcinoma of rectosigmoid

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 41
cards.title: Obrázok 41 – Karcinóm rektosigmy – MR, T2 (374)

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 44
cards.title: Obrázok 44 – Hernia abdominalis – postkontrastné CT (377)
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT-axial view
Free gas in peritoneal cavity (full arrow)->pneumoperitoneum
Leak of contrast medium from the stomach(broken arrow)-perforation of stomach ulcer ->perforation of
ulcer ventriculis

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 14
cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 14
cards.description:
Translation:
Native CT examination (transverse slice/section):
Thickening of wall of sigmoid colon (colitis of sigmoid colon) (full arrow) with fluid accumulation in the
surroundings - forming an abscess (broken arrow).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 15
cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 15
cards.description:
Translation:
Post contrast CT examination (transverse slice/section):
Post contrast filling/saturation of thickened wall of sigmoid colon (colitis of sigmoid colon) (full arrow) with
fluid accumulation in the surroundings - forming an abscess (broken arrow).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 20
cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 20
cards.description:
Translation:
Post contrast MR examination - T1 weighted image (coronary slice/section):
Thickening and post contrast filling/saturation of wall in ileoceacal transition (arrow) - Crohn’s disease
(Crohn’s disease of terminal ileum).

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 21
cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 21
cards.description:
Translation:
Native CT examination (transverse slice/section):
Sigmoid colon with exterminated/loss of haustrations (arrow) - ulcerative colitis (ulcerative colitis).
«The wall of sigmoid colon is smoothened»

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 22
cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 22
cards.description:
Translation:
Post contrast CT – axial view
Post-contrast saturation of sigmoid wall, showing smoothed haustration ->Ulcerative colitis

cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 23
cards.description:

Native CT –axial view
Thin small intestines are dilated with fluid (small arrow), free fluid between loops of bowels (broken arrow),
left large intestine is not dilated (thick arrow)
-> Ileus of small intestine

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 28
cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 28
cards.description:

Native-CT – axial view
Native non-differentiated appendix. In right hypogastrium you can see free fluid (arrow)

cards.label: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 29
cards.title: Gastrointestinal tract | Obrazok 29
cards.description:
Translation:
Post-contrast CT – axial view
Tubular, blind-end structure in right hypogastrium, its wall is thickened and is saturated (full arrow). Around
it is free fluid (broken arrow)
->appendicitis
